turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Mumbai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Anjali from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm a transaction of twenty five thousand rupees made today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? I did not do any such transaction, oh my god.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, sir. This is just a verification call to make sure you are aware of the activity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What should I do? Do I need to give you my details to stop it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, please do not share any details. I will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or Aadhaar number over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But how will you help me if I don't give the information?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We only need your verbal confirmation. Just remember that the bank will never ask for your passwords or secret codes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I understand. I was getting very scared.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a common trick by scammers, so please be careful. You can visit your home branch in Mumbai if you still have doubts.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you, Anjali. I will be more careful from now on.
